Before: the settings record wasn't account-scoped, so tone, suggestions and natural voice carried to the next account. Fixed: settings scoped per account, language/theme/size device-wide; tests/settings-scope.test.mjs.

Before: two-tap removes existed but chat, file and reminder deletes did not say what stays. Fixed 0765a8b: each delete says what is kept (reminders and Library files after a chat; chats keep what Orivia read after a file; phone calendar copies after a reminder). tests/deletion-consequences.test.mjs.

Before: no way for a student to leave. Fixed 0765a8b: /api/me/orgs/:id/leave (confirm required, account header, sole admin must hand over, progress removed, audited) and a two-tap Leave control with an explanation. tests/leave-organisation.test.mjs (real Better Auth + SQLite; space 403 and chat context null after leaving). Rejoining uses the normal invitation flow.

Before: no university bookmarks existed (Ina 1f797f2: unverified). Built 16b8776: references only, membership re-checked each Library draw, Open reloads from the server, Ask through the server-checked context, title-only after leaving or removal. tests/org-bookmarks.test.mjs; docs/evidence/screens/lib-005-bookmarks-phone.png.

Before: other tabs reloaded on sign-in/switch/sign-out (BroadcastChannel) and the server refuses a mismatched account header (409 account_changed), but an unsent draft in the reloading tab was lost. Fixed: the draft is held under the account it was typed in (sessionStorage key by account id) before the reload and returns only to that account. tests/tab-account-switch.test.mjs; tests/device-accounts.test.mjs.

Roles come from server tables only: tests/organisations.test.mjs:119-120 (owner not inferred from email domain or request content), :49 (university email does not auto-enrol), :129-141 (no self-promotion, demotion takes effect next request); tests/staff-tenant-matrix.test.mjs (every staff route refused to students and other organisations' staff; owner routes refused to every organisation role).

Before: last-owner and sole-admin deletion were refused on the server (tests/organisations.test.mjs:108) but the app said only "That didn’t work", and no recovery procedure existed. Fixed: the account panel explains both refusals; no Worker route writes platform_roles; docs/owner-recovery.md (second owner, lost mailbox, private notes). tests/owner-recovery.test.mjs.

No impersonation or browse-everything route: owner overview and export carry no identities or private content, owner role is refused on every organisation staff route (tests/staff-tenant-matrix.test.mjs; tests/organisations.test.mjs:40 owner cannot list members); feedback queue excludes identity (tests/feedback.test.mjs).

New tests/staff-tenant-matrix.test.mjs: 181 hostile calls over every /api/orgs/:id route and method, the owner routes and the CSV export, by other-organisation admins and editors, students, pending members, the platform owner and signed-out callers, plus object substitution (own organisation id with the other organisation's content, member, invitation, request and code ids) and cross-site origin; all refused and organisation B's rows byte-identical afterwards.

tests/organisations.test.mjs:49,52 (verified university email and pending membership expose nothing), :105-106 (invitation secrets not accepted in URLs or by others), :72-76 (public codes are public content only; revoked code 404); joining requires staff approval before member content.

Context is a reference, re-read on the server for every request: tests/university-chat.test.mjs:47,50 (left or removed → readOrgContext null on the very next message), trial returns 403 org_context_unavailable before any model call, client clears the context and labels "Using <university>’s …".

No product analytics pipeline exists; Worker logs carry codes and counts only: tests/assistant.test.mjs:86 (assistant log holds outcome codes, not chat text or names), notifications/feedback logs are fixed codes (workers/accounts/notifications.mjs:43,64; feedback.mjs:59); feedback stores no identity in the owner queue.

Unavailable is never 0: tests/owner-overview.test.mjs:48-54,81-84 (missing budgets/feedback → unavailable/null), tests/metric-definitions.test.mjs (Paused/Unavailable documented; university dashboard says guide views and QR opens aren’t tracked and shows no rate).

tests/notification-client.test.mjs:8-11 (opening onboarding never prompts; Not now continues without a permission call; denied permission never subscribes; guests never asked); separate reminders/membership/updates preferences (tests/notifications.test.mjs:10-11) changeable in Settings.

tests/notification-isolation.test.mjs: a push carrying a visa appointment and passport number shows only fixed generic text; scheduler sends generic text (tests/notifications.test.mjs private title never on a lock screen).

Notifications carry no link: opening one always opens the app home, which re-checks sign-in, account and membership (app-sw.js notificationclick). New assertions in tests/notification-isolation.test.mjs: space, external and item URLs in notification data all open "/" only.

Gate held: production scheduled() delivers nothing and production push keys are empty (tests/notification-isolation.test.mjs:27-28). Enabling needs the founder approval, a real-device check and the disclosure version in the receipt.

Same-origin, session, account header and server roles on every route: tests/staff-tenant-matrix.test.mjs (direct endpoint attacks with manipulated ids, cross-site origin, mismatched account header), tests/organisations.test.mjs:86, tests/device-accounts.test.mjs, tests/files.test.mjs, tests/shares.test.mjs; account-specific storage (tests/account-client.test.mjs).

Human check before any chat (tests/myorivia-release.test.mjs:68), expired check keeps the agreement (:78), failed check shows the reason and Try again (tests/beta-start.test.mjs); per-person daily limit by salted hash and overall cap (tests/public-beta.test.mjs:57-65); assistant daily cap with retryAfter and provider spend limits (tests/research-pilot.test.mjs:99-103).

Text nodes for all user values (tests across chat-presentation, information-cards, place-card, content-details, shares with javascript: and <script> fixtures), CSV formula neutralised (tests/owner-overview.test.mjs:69-73); new tests/hostile-fetch.test.mjs: 20 private/numeric/local/credentialed/non-https/odd-port addresses refused without a request, off-host and downgrade redirects refused.

Before: an impossible date or time (30 February, 24:00) rolled over into another day instead of being refused. Fixed in zoneInstant. tests/transport-assistant-card.test.mjs (chosen driving mode retained, encoded driving links), tests/device-handoffs.test.mjs (Apple and Google routes), tests/place-card.test.mjs (driving stays driving in both map apps, also when starting from the current location).

Built without Orivia ever reading location: "Start from where I am instead" removes the starting point so the map app uses its own permission when opened, with a plain explanation and a landmark fallback; a route with no start says the same. tests/place-card.test.mjs (links, mode kept, toggle back, no navigator.geolocation anywhere in the app).

tests/transport-actions.test.mjs (no made-up numbers, broad origin asks), tests/transport-assistant-card.test.mjs (registered official source), tests/handoff-cards.test.mjs (sourced destinations only); no ETA, price or live arrival is produced without a source.

tests/handoff-cards.test.mjs:9-32: English, Arabic and user-language tabs (missing user-language version refused, not relabelled), large message, Listen in the selected language, Close stops speech and returns focus, nothing sent externally, no geolocation.

Microphone only on the dictation button (tests/dictation.test.mjs), photos/camera only through the file picker on tap, notifications only after an explicit choice and never blocking (tests/notification-client.test.mjs:8-11), location never requested by Orivia (tests/place-card.test.mjs). tests/assistant-timing.test.mjs (concurrent identical searches/pages deduplicated within a turn, bounded cache, request isolation, policy checks unchanged); one shared memberships request for menu, Home and Library (nav.js, reused 4 s, tests/navigation.test.mjs).

A goal with no reviewed guide gets no guide (tests/journey-intelligence.test.mjs:25,35,73-74 return null) and ordinary sourced chat help instead, so no false reviewed guide appears. Evidence-grounded personalised draft plans for uncovered goals are not built; tracked under JOURNEY-003.
tests/guide-cards.test.mjs: offer card with Follow guide / Save for later / Not now; Not now never saves; not offered again while following or after decline; refreshers only when asked.

Guides carry steps with source and review date, cost/time only when known (never invented), waiting-for and a "how to check" line, and applicability rules. Missing: explicit step dependencies ("what blocks it"), owner per step, and completion criteria as data. To build.

Steps support not started, in progress, waiting, done and not sure; Done is personal and never shown as approval. Missing: ready, waiting for organisation vs waiting for you, blocked, not applicable, Undo/history and the source of each state. To build.
"Ask Orivia about this step" prepares Chat with the guide and step named; context label, return-to-plan and account-switch behaviour still to verify.
Search and type tabs exist and filtered views never cross accounts (store is account-scoped). Missing: sort (recent / alphabetical / pinned) and filter by country/space. To build.

Files show "N of 100 MB used", refuse new uploads with allowance_full and a plain message (tests/files.test.mjs:57-60); device saves that fail say so and change nothing (tests/library-discoveries.test.mjs quota case, tests/calendar-changes.test.mjs storage failure); no eviction or truncation code exists.
